notes: The San Francisco Call's Saturday Real Estate and Financial Section for 2 July to 31 December 1910, from curiv_klamath_ver01, curiv_mecca_ver01 and curiv_needles_ver01. 27 Saturdays, 74 OCR pages. After June the section moves round the issue: two to four pages, starting anywhere from p. 8 to p. 13, and the REAL ESTATE AND FINANCIAL SECTION head is missing on many Saturdays, so the pages were found by their headlines; p. 6 is the bay-counties (Oakland) page every week and was not read. Every entry carries extra.record_date (1910 is after the 1909 renumbering). Same selection as the January-June batch: numbered sales, leases and offerings that say something about the building, and buildings located by corner, offset or name that come with an architect, a builder, an institution or a firm; permits and loans naming only a private owner were left out. Private buyers, sellers, lessors, lessees and owners are cut from raw (raw.note says where); notable people a published source names in the past (Theodore Roosevelt Jr., Leon and George H. Roos, Harris Weinstock, Phoebe Hearst, Walter D. Bliss, Virginia Fair Vanderbilt) are kept. Corner and offset entries were placed with research/tools/corner.py on the record's lot area against the roll's lot_area and a roll year near 1910; entries it could not place carry by_hand with the corner.py call that was read.

coverage.remaining: The permit, contract and loan paragraphs that name only a private owner (roughly 120 corner and offset entries across the 27 Saturdays) were not taken; they are the next corner.py batch for 1910. The Real Estate Transactions lists are metes-and-bounds and were not read for entries. Five Presidio Terrace tract-lot entries (lots 7-8, 19, 21, 32, 33-34) wait on a tract-lot to APN key.
coverage.note: 148 numbered-address mentions on the 74 pages (a regex count, including brokers' offices and out-of-town property), read one by one with the architect and corner passages. 450 findings: 135 at a street number, 315 by corner, offset, block face or name. 128 resolved (54 by hand), 322 unresolved - most because the corner's buildings are all later than 1913 or the record gives no lot size to choose between parcels, and 60 numbered addresses that EAS no longer has, that now split across parcels, or that land on a condominium. 125 published on 109 pages, 55 of them seeded; 3 declined.
